headline: A 4V4 CLASS SHOOTER IS BACK
body: Hundreds of thousands of loadout combos
caption:
Battle Bears Gold is back. SkyVu calls it "an award-winning 4v4 class shooter with more personality than sense!"

11 classes, 16 maps, and hundreds of thousands of loadout combinations.

Did you play the original? Drop your old username below 👇

headline: ALL 11 CLASSES
caption:
The full Battle Bears Gold roster: 11 hero classes, each with their own abilities.

Soldier: Oliver
Heavy: Riggs
Demolition: Tillman
Huggable: Huggable
Sniper: Astoria
Chub Scout: Wil
Engineer: Graham
Assault: B-1000
Assassin: Botch
Combat Tech: Saberi
Arbiter: Sanchez

Who are you maining on day one? 👇

headline: THE ARSENAL
caption:
The Battle Bears Gold arsenal, by the numbers:

🔫 80+ primary weapons
🔫 60+ secondary weapons
🗡️ 50+ melees
🧰 10 special equipment
🎩 200+ cosmetic items

What was your go-to loadout back in the day? 👇

headline: PICK YOUR BATTLE
caption:
Three competitive modes are listed for Battle Bears Gold:

⚔️ Team Deathmatch (TDM)
⚔️ Free for All (FFA)
💣 Plant the Bomb (PTB)

SkyVu calls Plant the Bomb "underrated." Agree? 👇

headline: THE CLASSICS RETURN
caption:
Iconic maps are coming back in Battle Bears Gold, including No Bears Land, Gold Digger and Space Oddity.

SkyVu says you can "even make some time for that yearly match on Steamyard Blues, most likely just for the soundtrack." 😂

Best map of all time? 👇

headline: GRAB YOUR GEAR
caption:
SkyVu's own words: "Grab your A Salt Rifle, Bearzooka and those Turkish SW Boots and fight it out with friends across beloved Battle Bears locations."

Which weapon are you equipping first? 👇

headline: CLIMB TO DIAMOND
body: Level up to access new items
caption:
Progression in Battle Bears Gold: increase your level to access new items, then climb the ranks all the way to Diamond.

How long until you hit Diamond? 👇

headline: STEAM PC, iOS & GOOGLE PLAY
caption:
Where can you play? SkyVu says Battle Bears Gold launches November 4 on Steam PC, iOS and Google Play.

The Steam page also lists cross-platform multiplayer, plus system requirements for both Windows and macOS.

PC or mobile? 👇
source: battlebears.com + Battle Bears Gold Steam page

headline: AWARD WINNER
caption:
Battle Bears Gold is a Best App Ever Awards winner, including 1st place for Best Action & Arcade Game and 1st place for Best Soundtrack. 🏆

That soundtrack still lives in our heads. Favorite track? 👇

headline: THE BANGERS ARE BACK
body: "This game has bangers so get ready to enjoy that awesome OST once again."
caption:
Straight from SkyVu: "Speaking of music, this game has bangers so get ready to enjoy that awesome OST once again." 🎵

Which map had the best music? 👇

headline: MADE BY HUMAN ARTISTS
body: "All assets in this game are created by human artists."
caption:
A note on the Battle Bears Gold Steam page: "All assets in this game are created by human artists." 🎨

Respect to the art team. Thoughts? 👇

headline: 5 PLAYTESTS DONE
body: Five Discord playtests, July to October 2026
Playtest 3 added a new map: Sky World (Sky Pirates)
caption:
SkyVu held five Battle Bears Gold playtests on the Battle Bears Discord between July and October 2026.

The third added auto matchmaking and a new map, Sky World, which SkyVu's reveal video calls Sky Pirates. 🗺️ The final test on Oct 15 ran on Windows, iOS and Android.

Did you get into any of the playtests? 👇
source: SkyVu announcements on Steam; SkyVu's "Sky Pirates Map Reveal" video

headline: THE ORIGINAL MOBILE SHOOTER
body: "Battle Bears Gold pioneered multiplayer shooter games on mobile and was the childhood of millions of gamers."
caption:
SkyVu on Battle Bears Gold: "Battle Bears Gold pioneered multiplayer shooter games on mobile and was the childhood of millions of gamers."

Now it's coming back to Steam PC and mobile. Where were you when you first played? 👇

headline: MADE IN OMAHA
body: SkyVu is the developer and publisher
caption:
Battle Bears Gold is developed and published by SkyVu, a studio based in Omaha, Nebraska. 🐻

Show some love to the team bringing it back 👇
source: Battle Bears Gold Steam page + Wikipedia

headline: WISHLIST ON STEAM
body: SkyVu says wishlists make a huge difference for visibility on Steam
caption:
Want Battle Bears Gold to succeed? Wishlist it on Steam.

SkyVu: "Wishlists make a huge difference and help support visibility on this platform."

Search "Battle Bears Gold" on Steam, or use the link in our bio. ✅
